tenderSchedule.description: Replacement of Platforms of Ashok Leyland and Tata Intra Model Auto Tipper Vehicles Deployed for Door-to-Door Solid Waste Collection in the Wards of Shivamogga City Corporation.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The complete authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Other details can be seen in the tender document.
The Department is not-responsible for any delay in accessing E-procurement portal.
modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only. More details should be collected from the office at working hours
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The Contractor shall be responsible for the safety of all activities on the Site.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder must submit an affidavit on a Non-Judicial Govt e-Stamp paper attested by notary public that the bidder firm are not been black listed or debarred by any of the Government departments CPSU / SPSU / Autonomous body or have not been found guilty of moral turpitude or convicted any economic offense or violated any laws by any court or any authority appointed to enforce any laws Should be of current Financial Year
Bidder must submit GST certificate Bidder must submit PAN certificate

The bidder shall have achieved an annual turnover of not less than Rs 35.40 lakh in any two of the last five financial years, 2021,22,to 2025,26. If UDIN not verified online bidder will be disqualified
The Bidder should be registered under companies act 2013/ partnership act/ sole proprietorship under relevant act.

The tenderer shall have experience in vehicle body fabrication, repair, automobile engineering, or similar works or services of any machines Or should have be a manufacturing company of such fabrication items Or authorized dealer for the fabrication of machineries to authorized dealer during the last five years. The bidder shall submit work orders along with satisfactory performance certificates/completion certificates issued by the respective Government Department as proof of experience.
